reviews_captured_by_me.text: We had a custom vanity made and it turned out absolutely breathtaking. From start to finish, the experience was wonderful. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was just right, especially when it came to choosing the perfect wood color for our space. His communication was excellent, and it was clear that he paid close attention to even the smallest details. The craftsmanship is stunning and far exceeded our expectations. We could not be happier and would highly recommend his work to anyone looking for a great product from a great craftsman.

reviews_captured_by_me.text: The experience working with Barak at Woodeye to get new kitchen cabinets to replace our very old ones was great from start to finish. We had a very good time working with him to plan the cabinets on a computer program he had. Barak was very responsive to our ideas. When we saw the cabinets we were blown away!! They were so beautiful. We had asked for oak on the outside, which is beautiful. But even the parts that don't show are beautiful. All the doors and drawers have that quiet closure mechanism, which seems so luxurious. And yet the cost of the cabinets from Woodeye was less than pre-made cabinets from some big company. We highly recommend Woodeye and Barak. The pictures we uploaded are before countertop installation.

Our introduction to Barak was through our contractor that had done a complete renovation of all our cabinets in the house, from a water leak in our crawlspace.

Barak’s professionalism and craftsmanship were a welcomed addition when our world had been turned upside down.

We are so happy with the quality of materials he uses, and his design sense shines on us every day. He even made a custom lazy Susan for us (attached photo).

I don’t hesitate to recommend him for any cabinetry/woodworking job, you will be pleased with the results.
